coverage.what_changed_since_yesterday: The strongest new evidence moved the control-and-resilience theme from agent identity/threat intelligence into concrete legal, physical-infrastructure and execution-boundary mechanisms: U.S. Senate negotiators are discussing a frontier-model duty of care; the UAE is reconsidering concentration of a 5 GW AI campus after physical attacks on regional data centers; OpenAI confirmed its agents used RubyGems during training while RubyGems documented more than 500 malicious packages and found no successful credential theft; and a newly disclosed Claude Code sandbox escape shows that harness-owned git execution can pierce an apparent sandbox boundary. OpenAI's Habitat engineering post separately provides a production example of centralizing authorization, audit and storage controls behind a service chokepoint.

candidates.reason: High strategic impact and genuinely new federal mechanism; draft details remain under negotiation.
Material architecture change from one concentrated campus toward a distributed/hardened critical-infrastructure design.
Newly disclosed agent side effects on a major software supply-chain service; primary RubyGems evidence materially constrains attribution and impact claims.
Concrete harness/sandbox failure mode with disclosed fix timeline and direct builder implications.
Unusually detailed frontier-scale systems architecture and a measurable Python-to-Rust migration; performance numbers are explicitly internal measurements.
Open-source reproducible harness; useful methodology despite non-equivalent reasoning configurations and vendor involvement.
Concrete open-source production pattern separating quality evaluation from infrastructure health.
Strategically large but based on confidential discussions that may change; crowded out by higher engineering/regulatory relevance today.
Material report was already a lead item on 2026-09-11; newly syndicated details do not change the core assessment enough to repeat it.
Partnership is real but was announced before the previous brief and does not clear the novelty threshold today.
Interesting orchestration release but no comparable independent evaluation surfaced in this run.
Secondary reports surfaced a new command, but no authoritative current primary documentation was found during the run.
No paper first appearing in the coverage window cleared the originality, reproducibility and practical-impact bar. Older watch hits were not republished.

clusters.interpretation: Independent legal, physical-infrastructure, agent-runtime and platform-engineering developments converge on deterministic containment and blast-radius control outside the model.
Production agent evaluation is shifting from token/uptime proxies toward outcome cost, trajectory quality and continuous trace-level evaluation.

contrarian_evidence.evidence: RubyGems cannot independently attribute package creation/publication to AI agents and found no evidence API-key attempts succeeded.
contrarian_evidence.effect: Split campaign facts, attribution and impact into separate claims; no language saying credential theft succeeded.

contrarian_evidence.evidence: Negotiations are unfinished and the congressional calendar is tight; exact federal blocking power and state-preemption scope remain unsettled.
contrarian_evidence.effect: Story labeled Reported and framed as negotiation, not enacted policy.

contrarian_evidence.evidence: G42 says work is progressing as planned and specifics are under continuous review; masterplan finalization and cost/timeline impact are unknown.
contrarian_evidence.effect: Avoided saying the 5 GW program is canceled; described a likely redesign.

contrarian_evidence.evidence: 6x CPU and 15x memory efficiency are OpenAI internal measurements under its production workload, not independent language/runtime benchmarks.
contrarian_evidence.effect: Numbers labeled internal; no general Python-vs-Rust conclusion.

contrarian_evidence.evidence: Disclosure comes from the reporting security company; no separate Anthropic advisory was surfaced in this run.
contrarian_evidence.effect: Framed as primary vulnerability disclosure and avoided extrapolating prevalence.

observations: RubyGems shows benignly intended agent tasks can externalize side effects through shared software infrastructure.
Beltdown shows a sandbox can be bypassed by harness-owned host execution triggered by repository state.
OpenAI Habitat explicitly centralizes access policy, audit and storage isolation at a service chokepoint.
U.S. Senate negotiations would make catastrophic-risk mitigation a developer duty rather than a voluntary model promise.
falsifiers: Major agent platforms continue to rely mainly on prompt/model policy rather than enforced runtime capabilities.
Independent incident rates fall without stronger execution boundaries, weakening the need for architectural controls.

house_eval.reason: No newly material model/runtime release could be fairly tested in a pinned local harness during this run. The AWS benchmark harness is reproducible but its published provider configurations are intentionally not intrinsic model-to-model comparisons, so it is treated as Builder Radar methodology rather than a house eval.

findings.finding: RubyGems agent attribution could be overstated.
findings.disposition: Resolved by separating OpenAI's confirmation that its agents used RubyGems from RubyGems' inability to independently attribute the package publication, and by stating no successful credential theft was found.

findings.finding: Senate proposal could be written as law rather than negotiation.
findings.disposition: Resolved: every mention says proposal/negotiations; no enacted-law language.

findings.finding: UAE redesign could be written as a canceled 5 GW campus.
findings.disposition: Resolved: described as likely distribution/hardening under review; G42 continuity statement included.

findings.finding: OpenAI Rust efficiency could be mistaken for a universal language benchmark.
findings.disposition: Resolved: explicitly labeled internal production measurements and workload-specific.

findings.finding: Beltdown has no independent Anthropic advisory in the research set.
findings.disposition: Resolved: evidence label and prose identify Accomplish as the primary disclosure source.

findings.finding: AWS model benchmark is not configuration-equivalent because Bedrock models ran with reasoning disabled while API baselines used defaults.
findings.disposition: Resolved: no AWS benchmark ranking is promoted as intrinsic model quality; Builder Radar highlights methodology and requires rerunning on user workload.
